The organization operates primarily within the United States, offering a <cite id="1">complete online curriculum featuring visual and audio instruction</cite> to support those behind bars. In its most recent financial reporting, the foundation recorded <cite id="2">total revenue of $1,460,391</cite>. While the organization maintains a positive reputation for its niche services, donors should note that <cite id="3">revenue declined 14% in the most recent year</cite>, falling from $1,460,391 in FY2023 to $1,263,096 in FY2024. Despite this contraction, Tayba Foundation maintains <cite id="4">a high overall score of 94.94.25/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong internal governance and accountability. The foundation’s work is particularly significant as it serves a population often overlooked by traditional social services, providing <cite id="5">Islamic education and life skills</cite> to approximately <cite id="6">2,299 beneficiaries</cite>. However, a critical concern for transparency is the data vintage; <cite id="7">no financial filings newer than FY2023 are available</cite> for public review.
